scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --no-default-features --features wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/preludio.wasm
scripts.build:ts: tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --sourcemap=external && cp pkg/preludio_bg.wasm dist/preludio_bg.wasm
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:ts
